_doc: Edge Discovery — SPINE variant. Measures the full production decision spine (CRT/Gaussian/ZoneGate/RR -> Fusion -> RegimeGovernor -> Decision -> ExecutionPlanner -> UltronRiskGate) under the research truth standard, by running it as the 'spine' hypothesis. apply_signal_defaults MUST be false so the runner keeps the spine's own SL/TP geometry. The `spine` block is read by ProductionSpineSource (not by ResearchConfig).

spine._prod_version_note: REPOINTED 2026-06-27 (deepdeektry -> canonical v2_multi_2026_04): the prior 'v2_multi_2026_04 - deepdeektry' pin was both stale (superseded by canonical v2 per research_config_spine_majors.json + ACTIVE_VERSION) AND non-loadable on the patch engine — its `governance` section lacks the required `promotion_margin` key, so ProductionSpineSource fail-fasts at model_registry.from_prod_config (KeyError, config-first doctrine). Repoint verified: canonical v2_multi_2026_04 runs the BNBUSDT spine clean (13 entries). The deepdeektry config was archived to configs/production/v2_multi_2026_04_deepdeektry_archived_*.json. v4_multi_2026_06 is NOT loadable on `patch` (requires pre-TP3-absent CRTConfig fields tp3_enabled/tp3_atr_multiplier/score_component_weights); to measure v4, check out the post-TP3 code line and set prod_version=v4_multi_2026_06.
